race.comment: NAVY NINA (2) looked good saluting at the Sunny Coast when resuming and winning rider Thompson sticks in the stirrups. Should be ready for the step-up in trip and will be right there when the whips are cracking. READY FOR AIMEE (3) may have suffered from the dreaded second-up syndrome two back but bounced right back with a strong win here last time out. Gets 3kg off with the claim and can go back-to-back without surprising. GAGNANTE ENCHERE (11) has placed four of eight over this distance range and is usually thereabouts. One for the exotics players. MONAKEED (8) strips fitter second-up, gets 3kg weight relief and draws the inside marble. Ticks a few boxes for a race of this nature. The well-related EL CENTRO (1) (half to 2xG2 winner Yes Baby Yes) next in line.
